title: GTA 6 Becomes Most Pre-Ordered Digital Game in PS Store History
description: With a week until release, Rockstar Games' GTA 6 has officially been confirmed as the most pre-ordered digital game in PlayStation Store history.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## A Historic Milestone for PlayStation Store

It was always anticipated to be a monumental release, but with just a week remaining until its official launch, Rockstar Games has secured yet another historic milestone. According to recent reports from gaming outlet Push Square, *GTA 6* has officially broken the record to become the most pre-ordered digital game in the history of the PlayStation Store.

The groundbreaking confirmation comes courtesy of the official PlayStation Blog, via a post written by Sony's Tim Turi. While industry analysts and fans alike expected massive numbers from the return to Vice City, securing the all-time digital pre-order crown on PlayStation's premier digital storefront highlights the unprecedented level of hype surrounding the title.

## Unprecedented Hype Ahead of Launch

The confirmation sheds light on the sheer scale of digital consumer adoption for what is shaping up to be the biggest entertainment launch of the decade. As anticipation reaches a fever pitch with only a week left on the calendar, the community's eagerness to experience Rockstar's next epic has translated into record-breaking commercial momentum on the PS5.

## Editor's Take

Breaking the all-time PS Store digital pre-order record underscores the unmatched cultural and commercial weight of *GTA 6*. As the launch window finally arrives, Rockstar has once again proven that the franchise stands alone at the pinnacle of the gaming industry.
